text:
dana: Heads up 5 Asteria Labs (acct AL-442) has invoice INV-2026-189 for $12,450 overdue. We sent the first dunning on 1978884000 and follow-up yesterday. Customer replied asking for a short deferral because of quarter-end cashflow issues and asked for a line-item breakdown.

emily: Can you paste the invoice lines? I want to check whether any promotional credits or trial pricing applied.

dana: Pasting export snippet (redacted):

```
INV-2026-189
- Reserved monthly compute: $8,000
- Additional token usage: $4,750
- Trial credit adjustment: -$300
Total: $12,450
```

dana: Customer says they identified a test environment that sent traffic to production for ~36 hours on 2026-03-04; theyve paused the jobs and provided a ticket id but no remediation attestation yet.

jon: That's our top customer for that segment, want to avoid churn. Suggest offering a short deferral: 50% due now, remainder in 30 days, no interest, conditioned on remediation attestation and schedule for closing the bug. @priya any concerns?

priya: OK with deferral in principle, but we should add a small admin fee to cover collections cost and stipulate acceptance doesn't waive dispute rights. Propose 1% fee on outstanding. Also require ACH or PO before we ship the deferral agreement.

dana: Numbers with 1% fee: total = $12,450 + 1% = $12,574.50. 50% up front = $6,287.25, remainder $6,287.25 due in 30 days.

emily: Alternative: 2 equal installments (30/60 days) to reduce near-term burden. Either way require signed remediation doc and access to a single trace sample for verification.

customer-rep: Thanks for quick responses. We can do 50/50, will sign the remediation attestation and provide ACH by next Tue. We also asked for a brief credit for the part of the spike that matches known bug signatures.

jon: Don't promise credits without approval. If they want a credit it needs RevOps + RevEng audit. We can offer conditional review: if audit shows platform routing caused the spike, we issue pro-rated credit.

priya: Agreed, conditional credit only. Dana, draft the deferral email with the fee and terms, 72h acceptance window, and include the bit about credits subject to audit.

dana: Draft below, please review before I send:

"Hi Asteria team,

We can approve a 50/50 deferral for INV-2026-189 as follows: $6,287.25 due within 7 days, $6,287.25 due in 30 days. A 1% admin fee has been added. This offer requires: (1) signed remediation attestation within 72 hours, (2) ACH setup or PO before the first payment, and (3) access to a small trace sample for our audit. Any request for a credit will be evaluated after our audit; if we determine the spike was caused by our platform we will issue a pro-rated credit. Acceptance of this payment plan does not waive our right to pursue collections if the customer misrepresents facts. Please respond within 72 hours to accept.

Thanks,
AR Team"

priya: Language looks fine. Add a one-line clause that acceptance is not an admission of liability by either party.

dana: Added and will send once approved.

collections-bot: reminder email sent to Asteria Labs at 1978888070.

emily: Also flag to RevEng for an expedited 48h audit; if they can confirm client-side cause we avoid credits.

jon: I'll loop in the AE to keep the relationship warm. If they accept, let's mark this as a "managed deferral" in the collections tracker and set a follow-up for 2026-05-01.

customer-rep: Confirmed they'll aim to accept within 48h and send ACH details. Appreciate quick turnaround.

dana: (sent) Deferral email sent at 1978888124, cc RevOps and Legal. Will update when they accept. :white_check_mark:
